항목.프롬프트: Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game, one single full-bleed scene with no border and no frame: at sunset on the plateau of Bashan the huge giant king Og, a giant with a long black beard, an iron crown and dark iron scale armor with a black-and-crimson cloak has dropped his iron mace and kneels on one knee with a calm face, while the dark shadow creature that held him by strings breaks apart and flees into the sky; in front of him stands Caleb, a strong Israelite warrior of about thirty with a full, neat, short dark brown beard that evenly covers his chin, jaw and both cheeks, connected to his moustache, and dark hair, a bright brave face, wearing a green-and-tan wool tunic with a brown leather belt, leather bracers and a cream headcloth, holding a bow, with a few Israelite men behind him, all safe; warm golden light pours from the sky; no blood, nobody lying on the ground. Every person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet.
